title: A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy
abstract: arXiv:2610.31642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard implementations of softmax, log-softmax, and cross-entropy have two numerical bugs. The first bug, Softmax Collapse, rounds the target logit's gradient to zero if that one logit is much larger than the others, resulting in gradients that no longer sum to zero. The second bug, Softmax Cancellation, occurs when student logits are close to teacher logits, and produces non-zero gradients even when the student and teacher logits are equal. We present simple implementations of log-softmax, softmax, and cross-entropy that fix both bugs. Our fix eliminates the previously-observed "Slingshot" phenomenon, speeds up grokking with weight decay, prevents accuracy collapse without weight decay, stops student networks from drifting away from the teacher during distillation, and shows that after memorization, logit growth is bounded by an equilibrium between weight decay and Adam's $\epsilon$ hyperparameter.

translated_abstract: softmax、log-softmax和交叉熵的标准实现存在两个数值缺陷。第一个缺陷是“Softmax坍缩”，当某个logit远大于其他logit时，该目标logit的梯度会被舍入为零，导致梯度之和不再为零。第二个缺陷是“Softmax抵消”，发生在学生logit接近教师logit时，即使学生和教师的logit完全相等，也会产生非零梯度。我们提出了log-softmax、softmax和交叉熵的简单实现，修复了这两个缺陷。我们的修复方法消除了此前观察到的“弹弓”现象，在使用权重衰减时加速了grokking（顿悟）过程，在没有权重衰减时防止了准确率崩溃，阻止了蒸馏过程中学生网络偏离教师网络，并表明在记忆化之后，logit的增长受到权重衰减与Adam的ε超参数之间平衡的约束。
tldr: 该论文发现了softmax、log-softmax和交叉熵标准实现中的两个数值缺陷，并提出了简单的修复方案，该方案消除了“弹弓”现象、加速grokking、防止准确率崩溃并稳定了知识蒸馏过程。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies two numerical bugs in standard softmax, log-softmax, and cross-entropy implementations and presents simple fixes that eliminate the "Slingshot" phenomenon, speed up grokking, prevent accuracy collapse, and stabilize knowledge distillation.
